svg.title: The first request to my-counter-1
svg.desc: Six lifelines, each under a small drawing of its party: curl as a terminal, the kubectl ate proxy actor as a small unit with the Kubernetes mark, atenet-router as a gateway with the Envoy mark, ate-api-server as a server with the Agent Substrate mark, Postgres as a cylinder with its mark, and the worker pod as a frame that holds a gVisor sandbox and the actor. Nine numbered exchanges: curl sends POST to 127.0.0.1:8000, the proxy opens an mTLS CONNECT to router port 8444 through a kube-apiserver port-forward, the router calls ResumeActor, ate-api-server reads the actor row and finds it suspended, takes the lease and binds a worker, has atelet restore the golden snapshot so the actor goes from SUSPENDED to RUNNING, and returns worker 10.244.0.23 to the router. The router opens a CONNECT to worker port 8443, and curl gets 200 with count 1 after 0.358 seconds. Steps 5 and 6 have amber numbers because they happen only when the actor is suspended. In a later resume of the same actor the restore took 0.25 seconds, and a request to the running actor took 0.067 seconds.

g.text: take the lease, bind a worker
SUSPENDED to RUNNING, 0.25 s in a later resume

svg.text: only when the actor is suspended. A running actor skips them and answers in 0.067 s.
